title: China Price Check: Swiss Summit Train $155 vs China's $11 | China Travel Expert
description:
Switzerland's famous Gornergrat summit train costs about $155 round trip. The same kind of world-famous mountain view in China — Huangshan by cable car — costs about $11. Same sea of clouds, a fraction of the price.

Gornergrat is the cogwheel railway above Zermatt; Huangshan's Yungu cable car lifts you straight into the Yellow Mountains, where cloud inversions flood the granite peaks a big share of the year. The Swiss ride is the bucket-list splurge; the Chinese one is pocket change — and both end on an unforgettable summit panorama. (No Swiss footage is shown: the Swiss price is text only, and every image here is Huangshan.)

🧭 Expert Tip: ride the cable car up and hike down. The fare is one-way, so you only pay once and still save your knees on the descent.

瑞士戈尔内格拉特登山火车约 155 美元，黄山缆车约 11 美元——同样的云海山巅，价格差约 14 倍。
